name: const unsafe fn size_of_val_raw < T : ? Sized > (val : * const T) -> usize
rule: If the unsized tail of T is a trait object, calling size_of_val_raw(val) requires the size of the entire value, including the dynamic tail and statically sized prefix, in bytes to fit in isize.
api: const unsafe fn size_of_val_raw < T : ? Sized > (val : * const T) -> usize
